notes.title: Structura 1.0.5 release
notes.notes:
Structura 1.0.5

Bugfixes

Changelog:


 Attack timer displayed with minutes, seconds format
 Attach adds automatically 30 resources for components that need to be put online
 Fix some checks when using jump commands
 Text typos

notes.title: Structura 1.0.4 release
notes.notes:
Structura 1.0.4

Bugfixes

Changelog:


 Each game phase has its own music (Intro, Detection, Attack)
 Don't trigger the main attack in the standard tutorial
 Mass kinetic attack was happening too early (now moved after wave 10)
 sentinel reconstruct (only use energy to reconstruct)
 sentinel hull damage reduced when colliding with kinetic missiles (from 50 to 10)
 bugfix energy decrement not stopping at 0 in certain cases

notes.title: Structura release 0.8.0
notes.notes:
Structura

Changelog:

 Drop catapult on player command (by pressing Esc)
 New texture for unit
 Monoliths required to enter the gate
 Menu transport command left key fix
 Unit Upgrades,State,Stacks menu tooltips
 Text fixes
 Add rotation, adjust colors for kinetic missiles
 Defense nodes (red, green, blue, yellow)
 Defense nodes tooltips
 If all nodes are destroyed the mothership will be revealed
 Game win by mothership destruction
 Mothership execute a step every 60 secs
 Mothership change shield resistance every 30 secs
 Shield status tooltips text

notes.title: Structura release 0.7.9
notes.notes:
Structura 

Changelog:


 All menus commands have additional information, under the menu
 Changed the beginning mission text
 Cyber shield functionality, when active there's only a 30% chance for an enemy hacker to succeed
 After a unit jump the sentinel can move again
 Drop out of catapult in 2 cases:
if close to the shell gate
if close to shell edge
 "Get location" functionality, in the sentinel navigation menu
 Mothership node explode sound
 Destroyed unit texture
 Fixed a shell gate location bug
 Small fix for jump counters


End game:

 The message from command happens when entering the last gate
 Entering the last shell gate will jump the ship to the first gate
 Changed some texts

notes.title: Minor release 0.7.8
notes.notes:
Structura minor release

Changelog:

fixed crash when shooting enemies
move the attack timer to a better location on the screen
shell gates text hover
on game over only offer to quit , a new game can be chosen from the launcher
stack transfer operation menu
proper cleanup on enemy death


endgame work (work in progress):

added mothership nodes, each shell gate has 3 , initially cloaked
message from command when arriving on the last shell
trigger to decloak all mothership nodes
if all mothership nodes are destroyed, the mothership will be decloaked
the mothership will be a boss fight (still to do)

notes.title: Minor release 0.7.7
notes.notes:
Minor bug fix release, last release for 2020.

Changelog:

 tutorial text fixes
 advanced tutorial: prevent the main attack to start
 increased starting resources
 fix overlapping text when self-destruct/reconstruct sentinel
 block sentinel if the range is exceeded
 improved power plant effect
 fixed timer font for all resolutions


Happy new year!
